name: Gregg County, TX
findings: Gregg County has 402 nonprofit organizations. 129 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 106 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Gregg County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 45 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
